overview.implementation_summary: The codebase implements a multimodal 3D large language model (LLM) system through seven core functional modules: (M1) TrainingArguments orchestrates multi-stage training via configuration combinations; (M2) PointcloudEncoder injects projected point features into the language token stream using transformer-based encoding; (M3) PointNet2ClassificationSSG handles loading and filtering of conversation supervision alongside point sample processing; (M4) training_step converts point placeholders into multimodal training tokens; (M5) implements compact point-token aggregation with neighborhood routing via set abstraction modules; (M6) provides a shared projector (Encoder/PointcloudEncoder) bridging encoder space to LLM hidden space; and (M7) LLaVATrainer manages checkpoint and runtime saving behaviors. The system realizes a three-stage curriculum learning strategy (Text-First Warmup, Rich Instruction Alignment, Point-Language Transfer) to minimize dependence on large-scale 3D paired data.
overview.architecture_summary: Built upon PyTorch Lightning and LLaVA frameworks, the architecture integrates PointNet++ hierarchical set abstraction (PointnetSAModule, QueryAndGroup, Group) with LLaVA's multimodal projector design. The PointcloudEncoder (sn69) processes raw point clouds through grouping and transformer layers, while a shared projection layer (sn60, sn61, sn68) maps features to the LLM's embedding space. Supporting components include BNMomentumScheduler (sn2) for batch normalization management, PatchDropout (sn72) for regularization, and skeleton_Group (sn74) for compact token aggregation. The design maintains frozen or partially frozen backbone strategies during initial stages, with modality transfer occurring in Stage III.
overview.training_summary: Training follows a three-stage curriculum: Stage I (Text-First Interface Warmup) establishes projector-language coupling using DataCollatorForPointTextDataset (sn59) under frozen backbone conditions; Stage II expands to richer instruction/dialog patterns (implementation not explicitly found in snippets); Stage III (Point-Language Transfer) activates point-cloud token features using PointcloudEncoder (sn69) and ObjectPointCloudDataset (sn57). The training loop utilizes LightningModule's training_step (sn16) with ADAM optimizer (sn17), batch normalization momentum scheduling, and configurable argument combinations (sn64). Runtime mechanics including checkpoint flows are controlled via LLaVATrainer (sn63).
